title: NV Rabi/Zeeman visualizer export
description: Snapshot of index_rabi.html's current settings and every derived measurement shown on screen, for external validation against the closed-form physics documented in this repository's README, CLAUDE.md, and verify/. Field/naming conventions follow bell-state-explorer's export schema (dreads/bell-state-explorer schema/bell-state-export.schema.json) where the underlying data lines up, to ease later integration of these visualizers into one tool.

$schema.description: URI of this schema, so validators can dereference it without out-of-band configuration.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this export format, independent of the app's own version.

exportedAt.description: UTC timestamp the export was generated, RFC 3339 / ISO 8601.

distanceCm.description: Magnet distance from the fixed NV sensor, in cm (S.dist).

polarity.description: Which magnet pole faces the sensor; flips the sign of the local field (S.polarity).

rabiFreqMHz.description: On-resonance Rabi frequency Omega0/2pi, in MHz -- the microwave drive amplitude setting (S.rabi0).

driveFreqGHz.description: Fixed microwave drive frequency, in GHz (S.mw).

t2StarUs.description: Dephasing time T2*, in microseconds, used by the exp(-t/T2*) damping envelope (S.t2).

magnetStrength.description: Dipole-moment multiplier for the demo magnet, 1.0 = default (S.sens).

simTimeUs.description: The simulation clock at export time, in microseconds (S.t). Pause the page (the Pause time button) before exporting for a reproducible snapshot.

blochVector.description: [x, y, z] Bloch vector at simTimeUs, exact solution of H = (delta/2)sigma_z + (Omega0/2)sigma_x -- verified against QuTiP to ~1e-8 per verify/.

widthGHz.description: Lorentzian half-width used by the ODMR dip plot, in GHz.

contrastFraction.description: Per-dip contrast used by the ODMR plot.

odmr.description: The app's ODMR width/contrast are a hand-tuned demo heuristic (see README.md and verify/README.md), not derived from a rate equation -- included here as exactly what the page drew, not as a claim of physical accuracy.

fieldMt.description: Local magnetic field B at the sensor, in mT, from the real inverse-cube dipole law B(d) = B0/d^3.

resonancePlusGHz.description: Zeeman-shifted resonance f+ = 2.87 GHz + gamma*B, in GHz.

resonanceMinusGHz.description: Zeeman-shifted resonance f- = 2.87 GHz - gamma*B, in GHz.

detuningMHz.description: Signed detuning of the drive from the nearest resonance, in MHz.

onResonance.description: true when |detuningMHz| < 1.5, matching the on-resonance/detuned status badge shown in the UI.

rabiFreqEffectiveMHz.description: Generalized Rabi frequency Omega/2pi = sqrt(Omega0^2 + delta^2)/2pi, in MHz.

amplitudeFraction.description: Omega0^2/Omega^2 -- the population ceiling this detuning allows.
